notes.text: The threat of the plague of hail had fractured the ranks of Pharaoh's courtiers (9:20). The predicted invasion of locusts now leads to an open break with the king's policies. (Nahum Sarna, The JPS Torah

notes.text: A mighty strong west wind— ruach yam, literally the wind of the sea; the wind that blew from the Mediterranean Sea, which lay north-west of Egypt, which had the Red Sea on the east. Here again God works by natural means; he brought the locusts by the east wind, and took them away by the west or north-west wind, which carried them to the Red Sea where they were drowned. (Adam Clarke, Bible
